_what: Limits for how many of the files a person attaches are admitted, read by src/attachment-admission.mjs. Every limit is a row the owner can change without a build; a limit that is null or absent does not bind. `daily` is not kept here: the plan owner passes its remaining count and reset time as the `daily` input.

binding_words.per_turn: Only the first {admitted} of {offered} files were attached: one message holds up to {limit}.
binding_words.size: {name} was left out: it is larger than the {limit} a file may be.
binding_words.daily: Only the first {admitted} of {offered} files were attached: the daily limit of attachments is reached{reset}.
